Vek01Open.en: Episode four: Vekto. This is unpublished work in progress, so treat what follows as a status report.
Vek01Open.zh: 第四集：Vekto。这是尚未发表、仍在进行的工作，请把接下来的内容看作一份进展报告。

Vek01Open.en: We have seen counterexamples drive proof repair, and we have seen that a proof is only as good as its spec and its checker.
Vek01Open.zh: 我们已经看到 counterexample 如何推动证明修复，也看到一个证明的可信程度取决于它的 spec 和它的 checker。

Vek01Open.en: Now the code is real optimised SIMD kernels. Ported to another instruction set, does a kernel still compute the same thing, and which assumptions does that answer rely on?
Vek01Open.zh: 这一集的代码是真实的、经过优化的 SIMD kernel。移植到另一套指令集之后，kernel 还算出同样的结果吗？这个回答又依赖哪些假设？

Vek02Hook.en: Here is a kernel from XNNPACK, written for Arm NEON. It takes the element-wise maximum of two float arrays, four floats per step.
Vek02Hook.zh: 这是 XNNPACK 中一个为 Arm NEON 写的 kernel。它对两个 float 数组逐元素取最大值，每一步处理四个 float。

Vek02Hook.en: An LLM-driven pipeline, SALTy-RN, ported it to RISC-V Vector, RVV, and optimised it. We call this final optimised version B-opt.
Vek02Hook.zh: 一个由 LLM 驱动的流水线 SALTy-RN 把它移植到 RISC-V Vector（RVV）并做了优化。我们把这个最终优化版本叫作 Bopt。

Vek02Hook.en: Give both kernels a single element: a quiet NaN with payload 0x7fc12345, and the number 1.0.
Vek02Hook.zh: 给两个 kernel 同一个单元素输入：一个带 payload 0x7fc12345 的 quiet NaN，和数字 1.0。

Vek02Hook.en: The NEON kernel returns the NaN. The optimised RVV kernel returns 1.0. Same input, different output.
Vek02Hook.zh: NEON kernel 返回 NaN，优化后的 RVV kernel 返回 1.0。同一个输入，不同的输出。

Vek02Hook.en: This reproduces under QEMU at vector lengths 128, 256 and 512 bits, and swapping the inputs gives the same difference.
Vek02Hook.zh: 这个结果在 QEMU 中、向量长度 128、256 和 512 位下都能复现；交换两个输入，差异依然存在。

Vek03Lanes.en: Two terms first. SIMD, single instruction multiple data: one instruction works on a whole vector register, split into lanes.
Vek03Lanes.zh: 先解释两个术语。SIMD 是单指令多数据：一条指令作用于整个向量寄存器，寄存器被分成若干 lane。

Vek03Lanes.en: An intrinsic is a C function for one such instruction. vmaxq_f32 takes two registers of four floats and computes the maximum lane by lane.
Vek03Lanes.zh: intrinsic 是对应一条这类指令的 C 函数。vmaxq_f32 接收两个各含四个 float 的寄存器，逐 lane 取最大值。

Vek03Lanes.en: NEON registers have a fixed width. In RVV the register width, VLEN, differs between chips, and the program asks vsetvl how many elements it gets.
Vek03Lanes.zh: NEON 的寄存器宽度是固定的。RVV 的寄存器宽度 VLEN 因芯片而异，程序用 vsetvl 询问这次能处理多少个元素。

Vek03Lanes.en: In our counterexample only lane zero matters: NaN against 1.0. That one lane is where the two instruction sets disagree.
Vek03Lanes.zh: 在我们的 counterexample 中，只有第 0 个 lane 起作用：NaN 对 1.0。两套指令集正是在这一个 lane 上产生分歧。

Vek04Resolve.en: Why? Vekto gives every intrinsic a lane model. Arm FMAX propagates a NaN operand. RVV vfmax implements IEEE 754 maximumNumber, which ignores a single NaN.
Vek04Resolve.zh: 为什么？Vekto 给每个 intrinsic 一个 lane 模型。Arm FMAX 会传播 NaN 操作数；RVV vfmax 实现 IEEE 754 的 maximumNumber，会忽略单个 NaN。

Vek04Resolve.en: Which side is wrong? Nothing on XNNPACK's call path checks for NaN, so the input can occur. And there is no reference: the maintainers say min and max NaN behaviour is not guaranteed.
Vek04Resolve.zh: 哪一边错了？XNNPACK 的调用路径上没有任何 NaN 检查，所以这个输入确实可能出现。而且没有参考语义：维护者表示 min/max 的 NaN 行为不作保证。

Vek04Resolve.en: Vekto keeps the main result exactly as found: the original A is not equivalent to B-opt. It is recorded as divergence DIV-001.
Vek04Resolve.zh: Vekto 按原样保留主结果：原始 A 与 Bopt 不等价。它被登记为分歧记录 DIV-001。

Vek04Resolve.en: Separately, under an explicit condition, C-001, no NaN inputs, the register records a conditional result as passed and rechecked, counted on its own. That early evidence cannot be re-run here.
Vek04Resolve.zh: 另外，在显式条件 C-001（输入不含 NaN）下，登记表记录了一个条件结果，已通过并经复检，单独计数。这批早期证据无法在当前环境重跑。

Vek04Resolve.en: The alternative, repairing B-opt to propagate NaN, adds four statements after each vfmax. On Saturn RTL that costs 18.8 percent more cycles, as a geometric mean, and the repair was tested, not proved.
Vek04Resolve.zh: 另一种做法是修复 Bopt 让它传播 NaN：在每个 vfmax 之后加四条语句。在 Saturn RTL 上，这使周期数增加 18.8%（几何平均）；这个修复做过测试，但没有被证明。

Vek05Testing.en: Why didn't testing catch this? The repository records three ways that checks miss it.
Vek05Testing.zh: 为什么测试没有发现？仓库记录了检查漏掉它的三种方式。

Vek05Testing.en: First, XNNPACK's random test buffers replace NaN with zero, so its NaN assertion never fires on a NaN input.
Vek05Testing.zh: 第一，XNNPACK 的随机测试缓冲区会把 NaN 替换成 0，所以它的 NaN 断言从未在 NaN 输入上触发。

Vek05Testing.en: Second, QEMU leaves RVV tail lanes unchanged by default, so a tail-lane bug we found, XNN-003, stays hidden from XNNPACK's own tests.
Vek05Testing.zh: 第二，QEMU 默认保持 RVV 尾部 lane 不变，于是我们发现的一个尾部 lane bug（XNN-003）在 XNNPACK 自带的测试中无法暴露。

Vek05Testing.en: Third, SALTy-RN's own bounded checker said VERIFIED for this vmax pair, because its NEON model ignored NaN. With the model fixed, the same harness found the counterexample.
Vek05Testing.zh: 第三，SALTy-RN 自带的有界检查器对这一对 vmax 给出了 VERIFIED，因为它对这条 NEON 指令的模型忽略了 NaN。修正模型之后，同一个测试框架就找到了这个 counterexample。

Vek05Testing.en: This is Vero's lesson again: a verdict is only as good as the model and the spec behind it. Vekto aims for equivalence on every input that the spec's preconditions allow.
Vek05Testing.zh: 这又是 Vero 的教训：结论的可信程度取决于背后的模型和 spec。Vekto 的目标是：在 spec 前置条件允许的每一个输入上都证明等价。

Vek06Level.en: Where should such a proof live? There are three candidate levels: assembly with ISA models, a compiler IR, or C.
Vek06Level.zh: 这样的证明应该放在哪一层？有三个候选层次：带 ISA 模型的汇编、编译器 IR，或者 C。

Vek06Level.en: At the assembly level we would need separate ISA models for fixed-width NEON and length-agnostic RVV, plus a correspondence between them, and those models cover exceptions and privileged execution that kernels never use.
Vek06Level.zh: 在汇编层，需要分别为固定宽度的 NEON 和与向量长度无关的 RVV 建立 ISA 模型，再建立两者的对应关系；这些模型还涵盖 kernel 用不到的异常处理和特权执行。

Vek06Level.en: Vekto works at the C level. Every supported intrinsic gets an explicit C definition of its numerical and memory behaviour, and human experts review these definitions against the ISA documentation.
Vek06Level.zh: Vekto 选择在 C 层工作。每个支持的 intrinsic 都有一个显式的 C 定义，描述其数值行为和内存行为，并由人类专家对照 ISA 文档审查这些定义。

Vek07Pipeline.en: Here is the pipeline. It starts from the original kernels, kept byte-identical to upstream.
Vek07Pipeline.zh: 这是整个流水线。它从原始 kernel 出发，它们与上游逐字节一致。

Vek07Pipeline.en: The C verifier, QCP, mishandles vectors passed by value, so a deterministic rule tool rewrites just the vector statements into pointer form. No language model or person edits the sources.
Vek07Pipeline.zh: C 验证器 QCP 处理按值传递的向量时有缺陷，所以由一个确定性的规则工具只把涉及向量的语句改写成指针形式。源代码不由语言模型或人工修改。

Vek07Pipeline.en: QCP symbolically executes the annotated C and emits verification conditions, which agents then prove in Coq.
Vek07Pipeline.zh: QCP 对带标注的 C 代码做 symbolic execution，生成 verification condition，再由 agent 在 Coq 中证明。

Vek07Pipeline.en: Intrinsic calls resolve to one shared contract library, differentially tested against real instructions: natively for x86, under QEMU for NEON, RVV and Hexagon.
Vek07Pipeline.zh: intrinsic 调用统一对应一个共享的契约库，并与真实指令做差分测试：x86 在本机运行，NEON、RVV 和 Hexagon 在 QEMU 中运行。

Vek07Pipeline.en: The human-reviewed part is small: spec.c holds only equivalent, which runs both kernels on one input and relates their outputs.
Vek07Pipeline.zh: 需要人工审查的部分很小：spec.c 只包含函数 equivalent，它在同一输入上运行两个 kernel，并给出它们输出之间的关系。

Vek07Pipeline.en: Finally, check.py re-runs everything from an empty directory, and a package counts only if all twelve gates pass.
Vek07Pipeline.zh: 最后，check.py 在一个空目录中把一切从头重跑；只有十二道 gate 全部通过，这个包才算数。

Vek07Pipeline.en: When a proof fails, it becomes a concrete input, replayed on the original code, then triaged into an explicit condition, a minimal fix, or a recorded divergence. Our NaN took that path.
Vek07Pipeline.zh: 证明失败时，失败被转化为一个具体输入，在原始代码上重放，再分流为显式条件、最小修复或登记在案的分歧。我们的 NaN 走的就是这条路。

Vek08Gates.en: The twelve gates read like a checklist. The first four pin the inputs: sources identical to upstream, the rewrite regenerated byte for byte, libraries pinned and rebuilt.
Vek08Gates.zh: 这十二道 gate 就像一张检查清单。前四道固定输入：源代码与上游一致，改写结果逐字节重新生成，各个库固定版本并重新编译。

Vek08Gates.en: Then the proofs: every condition is closed with Qed, including the equivalence units, and Print Assumptions may list only whitelisted axioms.
Vek08Gates.zh: 接着是证明：每个 verification condition（包括等价性单元）都以 Qed 结束，Print Assumptions 只能列出白名单内的公理。

Vek08Gates.en: Next, trust checks: each kernel contract must be textually identical wherever it appears, and a scan rejects goals that a known QCP soundness bug could make vacuously true.
Vek08Gates.zh: 然后是信任检查：每个 kernel 契约在出现的每一处都必须文本一致；另有一次扫描，排除那些可能因 QCP 一个已知 soundness bug 而空洞成立的目标。

Vek08Gates.en: A concrete witness shows the precondition is satisfiable, so the proof is not about an empty input set, and every callee must be a proved body or a pinned library contract.
Vek08Gates.zh: 一个具体见证说明前置条件可以满足，因此证明讨论的不是空的输入集合。并且每个被调用函数都必须是已证明的函数体，或是固定版本的库契约。

Vek08Gates.en: Last, the library models and the two original kernels are tested against each other.
Vek08Gates.zh: 最后，库模型与两个原始 kernel 相互做测试比对。

Vek09Walk.en: Now one complete package, x24-transposec, which transposes blocks of three-byte pixels. The source is XNNPACK's x86 SSSE3 kernel.
Vek09Walk.zh: 现在看一个完整的包：x24-transposec，它转置由三字节像素构成的块。源程序是 XNNPACK 的 x86 SSSE3 kernel。

Vek09Walk.en: It works on four-by-four tiles with 16-byte loads, unpacks and byte shuffles. Its loads may read past the bytes it needs, which XNNPACK declares.
Vek09Walk.zh: 它按四乘四的 tile 工作，使用 16 字节加载、unpack 和字节 shuffle。它的加载可能读到所需字节之外，XNNPACK 对此做了声明。

Vek09Walk.en: The RVV target is new code. It handles one column per pass: vsetvl picks how many rows fit, and a strided segment load does the transpose itself.
Vek09Walk.zh: RVV 目标程序是新写的代码。它每一轮处理一列：vsetvl 决定能放下多少行，一条 strided segment load 本身就完成了转置。

Vek09Walk.en: The spec, equivalent, runs both kernels on the same input into two separate output buffers.
Vek09Walk.zh: spec 中的 equivalent 在同一个输入上运行两个 kernel，结果写入两个独立的输出缓冲区。

Vek09Walk.en: Its precondition names the conditions: blocks at least one by one, C-022, and the input window C-033, since x86 may read to the end of a 16-byte vector while RVV reads only a prefix.
Vek09Walk.zh: 它的前置条件写出了带编号的条件：块至少为一乘一，即 C-022；以及输入窗口 C-033，因为 x86 一侧可能读到 16 字节向量的末尾，而 RVV 只读其中的前缀。

Vek09Walk.en: The postcondition is outputs_related: the two outputs agree on every byte that a transpose writes.
Vek09Walk.zh: 后置条件是 outputs_related：两个输出在转置会写入的每一个字节上都一致。

Vek10Results.en: The supervisor re-ran check.py for this package from an empty directory. The record reports RESULT PASS: twelve of twelve gates, in 5,990 seconds.
Vek10Results.zh: 监督者在一个空目录中为这个包重跑了 check.py。记录显示 RESULT PASS：十二道 gate 全部通过，用时 5,990 秒。

Vek10Results.en: QCP produced 435 verification conditions for the x86 kernel and 22 for the RVV kernel at each vector length, and all of them are closed in Coq.
Vek10Results.zh: QCP 为 x86 kernel 生成了 435 个 verification condition，为 RVV kernel 在每个向量长度下各生成 22 个，全部在 Coq 中证完。

Vek10Results.en: The assumptions stay on screen. The result holds at three fixed vector lengths, 128, 256 and 512 bits, not at any length, and under conditions C-022, C-024, C-031 and the window C-033.
Vek10Results.zh: 假设要始终留在屏幕上。结果只在三个固定向量长度 128、256 和 512 位下成立，并非任意长度，且依赖条件 C-022、C-024、C-031 和输入窗口 C-033。

Vek10Results.en: Globally, this is partial correctness, intrinsic semantics rest on reviewed contracts and tests rather than a formal ISA proof, and six constant tables are assumed aligned.
Vek10Results.zh: 从全局看，这是部分正确性；intrinsic 的语义依赖经审查的契约和测试，而不是相对 ISA 的形式化证明；另外假设六个常量表是对齐的。

Vek10Results.en: Of 25 edge cases outside the domain, 14 behave differently, such as block width zero: exactly what C-022 excludes.
Vek10Results.zh: 在定义域之外的 25 个边界用例中，有 14 个行为不同，例如块宽为 0：这正是 C-022 排除的输入。

Vek11Status.en: As of November 23, 2026: E1 asks whether LLM-optimised RVV kernels verify against their NEON originals without rewriting. It is in progress: 17 approval records so far, most keeping the main result that A is not equivalent to B-opt.
Vek11Status.zh: 截至 2026 年 11 月 23 日：E1 研究 LLM 优化后的 RVV kernel 能否不经改写、相对 NEON 原版得到验证。它仍在进行中：目前有 17 份审批记录，多数保留了“A 与 Bopt 不等价”的主结果。

Vek11Status.en: E2 translates x86 operations that RVV and Hexagon lack and proves each translation: 24 approved migrations, with a Hexagon port of x64-transposec still in progress.
Vek11Status.zh: E2 把 RVV 和 Hexagon 缺少的 x86 操作翻译过去，并证明每次翻译：已批准 24 个迁移，x64-transposec 的 Hexagon 移植仍在进行中。

Vek11Status.en: E3 cross-checks independent XNNPACK implementations of the same operator: 14 pairs are approved, one pair was proved not equivalent, and three planned pairs have not started.
Vek11Status.zh: E3 交叉检查同一算子在 XNNPACK 中的不同独立实现：14 对已批准，一对被证明不等价，另有三对计划中的配对尚未开始。

Vek11Status.en: E4, one application-level program, with softmax as the candidate, has not started. So none of this is a program-level result yet.
Vek11Status.zh: E4 针对一个应用级程序，候选是 softmax，目前尚未开始。所以以上都还不是程序级的结果。

Vek12Close.en: Vekto does not claim termination or a link from C to machine code. Hexagon is modelled as 64-bit though it is 32-bit, in-place calls are not covered, and no bug found has been reported upstream yet.
Vek12Close.zh: Vekto 不声称终止性，也不声称 C 与机器码之间的对应。Hexagon 是 32 位平台，却按 64 位建模；原地调用没有覆盖；发现的 bug 目前都还没有向上游报告。

Vek12Close.en: Across the series, the counterexample took four forms: a program state in ExVerus, a learned explanation in TopoVerus, an audit of a spec in Vero, and an input on which two kernels disagree in Vekto.
Vek12Close.zh: 回顾整个系列，counterexample 有四种形态：ExVerus 中的程序状态，TopoVerus 中学到的解释，Vero 中对 spec 的审计，以及 Vekto 中让两个 kernel 产生分歧的输入。

Vek12Close.en: And one trust thread held throughout: every proof re-checked, no spec silently weakened, every assumption stated.
Vek12Close.zh: 贯穿始终的是同一条信任主线：每个证明都被重新检查，没有任何 spec 被悄悄削弱，每个假设都明确写出。
